```python
import DREAM
from DREAM.Settings import DREAMSettings
from DREAM.Settings.Equations import EquationSystem
from DREAM.Settings.RadialGrid import RadialGrid
from DREAM.Settings.Solver import SolverNonLinear
from DREAM.Settings.TimeStepper import TimeStepper

# Create DREAM settings object
ds = DREAMSettings()

# Set up radial grid
ds.radialgrid.setNr(5)
ds.radialgrid.setMinorRadius(0.22)
ds.radialgrid.setWallRadius(0.24)

# Set up momentum grid for both hot-tail and runaway grids
ds.hottailgrid.setNxi(40)
ds.hottailgrid.setNp(200)
ds.hottailgrid.setPmax(2)

ds.runawaygrid.setNxi(40)
ds.runawaygrid.setNp(200)
ds.runawaygrid.setPmax(100)

# Set initial plasma parameters
E_field = 3.0     # V/m
n_e = 5e19        # m^-3
T_e = 2e3         # eV

ds.eqsys.E_field.setPrescribedData(E_field)
ds.eqsys.n_cold.setPrescribedData(n_e)
ds.eqsys.T_cold.setPrescribedData(T_e)

# Set up initial hot electron Maxwellian
ds.eqsys.f_hot.setInitialProfiles(n0=n_e, T0=T_e, rT0=0, rN0=0)
ds.eqsys.f_hot.setInitType(ds.eqsys.f_hot.INITIAL_MAXWELLIAN)

# Enable Dreicer and avalanche generation
ds.eqsys.n_re.setDreicer(True)
ds.eqsys.n_re.setAvalanche(True)

# Disable the runaway grid (use only hot-tail grid for kinetic simulation)
ds.runawaygrid.setEnabled(False)

# Set Svensson transport coefficients
ds.eqsys.f_hot.setSvenssonCoeff(D=1.0, V=0.0)

# Use nonlinear solver
ds.solver.setType(SolverNonLinear)

# Set time stepper
ds.timestep.setTmax(1e-3)
ds.timestep.setNt(20)

# Save settings to HDF5 file
ds.save('dream_fluid_kinetic_simulation_settings.h5')
```
